Microsoft's gross margin in fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) was about 67.2% of revenue.

- Gross margin was $60,482 million, per Microsoft's Q4 FY26 press release.
- Revenue was about $90.01 billion, per a Webull earnings summary.
- $60,482 million ÷ $90,010 million ≈ 67.2%.

That is down from 68.6% in the prior-year quarter, when gross margin was $52,427 million on revenue of about $76.4 billion. I took the revenue figure from the Webull summary, not from the press release itself. The press-release text I retrieved didn't include the revenue line.
